title: Legacy knights and knaves restore script
user_messages: Let's reason through a logic puzzle together — think it through in words, and don't write or run any code. On an island, every inhabitant is either a knight (always tells the truth) or a knave (always lies). You meet two people, A and B. A says: "At least one of us is a knave." What are A and B?
Walk me through why A cannot be a knave.
Now a harder variant: A says "B is a knight" and B says "We are of opposite types." What are A and B?
I think you made a mistake — check your reasoning about B again.
Good. Now a different challenge: can a single inhabitant ever truthfully say "I am a knave"? Reason it out.
Summarize the key reasoning principles we covered as a numbered list.
operator_actions: After user message 4 is answered, restore to immediately after user message 3.
